_doc.bounce_s: an up followed by a down within this many seconds is a release bounce: the press continues
_doc.drift_samples: samples dropped before lift-off (XPT2046 positions drift as the finger lifts)
_doc.min_samples: samples needed before a press is real (also the median window for the down position)
_doc.drag_px: movement before a press becomes a drag
_doc.double_tap_s: max gap between taps of a double-tap
_doc.edge_correction_px: added to x for touches near the left edge (taps there read 7-15 px left); 0 = off
